lengthGroups.name: CSI pairs, P4 side
lengthGroups.why: layout.md Camera: pair-to-pair length match ≤ 0.762 mm (30 mil), each pair's mean, from U6 to the 0 Ω links R45–R47/R49–R51 (Espressif HDG §1.4.6); not a DRC rule because a second skew rule would replace the intra-pair one

lengthGroups.name: CAM pairs, FPC side
lengthGroups.why: layout.md Camera: pair-to-pair length match ≤ 0.762 mm (30 mil), each pair's mean, from the 0 Ω links to J4 (Espressif HDG §1.4.6); not a DRC rule because a second skew rule would replace the intra-pair one

paths.name: REF_CLK branches
paths.why: layout.md Ethernet: from the star point at R13 pin 2, both REF_CLK branches (to U1 pin 10 and U6 pin 68, GPIO50) ≤ 20 mm and equal; IP101G DS §6.1 asks the clock trace to the PHY to equal the one to the MAC, with no tolerance. 1 mm is ≤ 7 ps of skew (≈ 7 ps/mm on an inner layer), negligible against the ≈ 2 ns RX setup margin in ethernet.md, so it reads 'equal' strictly and is easy to meet with the length tuner

paths.name: BOOT stub
paths.why: layout.md MCU and USB: R39 (and R38) sit directly on the RMII_TXD1_MCU trace between U6 pin 47 and R36, so the BOOT strap stub stays a few mm (≤ 3 mm from R36.1 to R39.1): TXD1 is synchronous to the 50 MHz REF_CLK

viaParity.name: CSI lanes, P4 side

heightZones.name: lens view cone
heightZones.why: layout.md Camera opening: the lens view cone is r 7.0 mm at the front face and widens 0.83 mm per mm of height, so a part h mm tall sits ≥ 7.0 + 0.83 h from the lens axis. Heights are datasheet maximums (DP1435, HR871150C, JVE, RVT, SVZ, MA, RH-5002, TYPE-C-31-M-12, FXL0630, FNR4030S, SH, AFA07, SS16, IRLR024N, A-SC880IR3C, TS-1187A, WS2812B-2020, RUX0012A, LSM6DS3TR-C, TSX-3225) and Waveshare's published module height; chip passives, SOT-23, SOD-323, QFN-32 and WSON-6 are package-typical maximums (estimate)
